co_residency: Two single-model service contexts started in order (front first); total reservation 0.90. The V1 paired launcher (<=0.40 each) is not used because Qwen3.5-9B needs 16.8 GiB of weights.

cascade_policy.choice_note: Most accurate frozen V3 cascade with the 9B fallback; chosen with knowledge of test accuracy

workload.cycling: Shuffled complete cycles; common Poisson arrivals and sample sequence for each repeat/rate across all conditions

warmup.mode: serial; cascade calls both models per input

order: Deterministically shuffle conditions within each repeat and rates within each condition
cell_isolation: Fresh owned services and warmup for every cell; stop all owned process groups after each cell
feasibility_preflight: Before formal cells: start the cascade services, run the 90 development inputs through both models serially, record GPU memory; stop on failure without changing reservations
primary_metric: Correct goodput at the 500 ms SLO: median, min and max over 3 repeats per condition and rate
comparisons: startlux9b versus cascade at each rate with paired schedules, startlux4b listed alongside
Highest tested rate at which every repeat has at least 99% of offers on time
Consistency: accuracy of successful responses versus offline results; per-input cascade routing versus V3 offline decisions; label variability across repeats
interpretation_limits: Quality is retrospective on the ANLI test already evaluated in V3
Three repeats describe service variability; no significance test
Capacity statements are limited to the tested rates and this client and vLLM configuration
No dollar cost; resources reported as GPU reservation, sampled memory and GPU time
